metadata.title: Single-Country EM ETFs (EWT/EWZ/FXI) — USD Wrapper Diagnostic
references: Patton (2011). Volatility forecast comparison. J Econometrics 160:246-256.
Hansen & Lunde (2005). A forecast comparison of volatility models.
upstream_experiments: K1075 SPY extended 2007-2026 DM t=+7.92 Harvey-PASS
K1078 QQQ extended 2007-2026 DM t=+5.99 Harvey-PASS
K1080 IWM extended 2007-2026 DM t=+4.80 Harvey-PASS
K1081 EEM extended 2007-2026 DM t=+5.25 Harvey-PASS
metadata.notes: EWT/EWZ start ~2000; FXI IPO 2004-10-05 -> at 2007-01-01 FXI has ~562 training obs vs WINDOW=2000 requested. Same max(0, abs_idx - WINDOW) policy as K1081 -> first refit uses all available history. Flag FXI Early_Crisis as training-light. VIX is the shared exogenous IV regressor (global risk-off signal; test currency vs structure not country-specific IV).

hypothesis_verdicts.H2_interpretation: EWT and 0050.TW both FAIL despite different currencies -> Taiwan market structure is unique (not currency).
hypothesis_verdicts.paper9_claim: Taiwan market structure itself is unusual for VIX-A4f: neither EWT (USD) nor 0050.TW (TWD) respond. Currency wrapper is not the explanation. Possible drivers: retail dominance, limit-up/down mechanism, concentrated TSMC exposure, or distinct macro volatility source.
hypothesis_verdicts.paper9_claim_nuanced: EWT (Taiwan, USD): DM t = +2.26 (directional win, not Harvey). 0050.TW (Taiwan, TWD): DM t = -0.49 (directional loss). Currency wrapper meaningfully shifts the VIX-A4f benefit (+2.75 t-units for identical stock composition), BUT Taiwan is still the weakest link among USD EM ETFs (EWT t=+2.26 < EWZ t=+2.33 < FXI t=+3.61 [Harvey-PASS] < EEM t=+5.25 [Harvey-PASS]). Taiwan concentration (TSMC ~40-50% of EWT) likely attenuates the VIX-A4f channel relative to diversified EM (EEM) or larger single-country exposures. Paper 9 conclusion: BOTH currency (USD vs TWD) AND composition (single-country Taiwan vs diversified) matter; neither alone fully explains the null.
hypothesis_verdicts.dm_shift_usd_vs_twd_taiwan: EWT (+2.26) - 0050.TW (-0.49) = +2.75 t-units attributable to USD wrapper for the same underlying stock composition.
